docs.summary:
A scene's physics simulation and the queries against it.

**Threading:** every member here is main-thread only, and queries additionally must not overlap each other. Jitter's own read paths are thread-safe, so this is Prowl's restriction rather than Jitter's: the query layer reuses scratch buffers, and a query first pushes pending Transform edits into their bodies. Breaking either rule is reported rather than silently returning wrong results. If you need a query from a job, marshal it back.

members.name: BakeMesh
members.signature: public static BakedPhysicsMesh BakeMesh(Mesh mesh)

docs.summary:
Bake (or fetch the cached) physics representation of a mesh. The bake is stored directly on the [`Mesh`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Mesh) instance ([`BakedPhysics`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Mesh)), so its lifetime is tied to the mesh rather than a separate global cache. The result is shared by every collider that uses the mesh, so the bake happens once instead of per MeshCollider instance, and is rebuilt automatically when the mesh's [`Version`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Mesh~Version) changes.

Thread-safe. The bake is pure CPU work, so this may be called from worker threads to pre-bake meshes off the main thread (independent meshes bake in parallel; each mesh locks on itself).
